_doc: STAGING. Barbecue is carolina, texas and chicago merged — the cultural bench's own suggestion, 'fold into a single Barbecue Regions pack'. Their condition governs the blurb and the boards: name whose tradition each region is, including the Black pitmasters Central Texas markets were built on. Three regions, and no board pretends one of them is the default.

theme.name: Barbecue
theme.blurb: Whole hog in the Carolinas, brisket in Central Texas, rib tips and hot links on the South Side — three traditions, one fire, and Black pitmasters in all three.

boards.scene: The South Side, and the aquarium smoker in the window

clues.potsie: Nobody's name for it. Everyone's name for the man who runs it
clues.tips: Rib. Chopped, on white bread, in a styrofoam box, and that IS the dish
clues.pit: Behind glass, so you watch your own dinner for twenty minutes
clues.post: Where the line forms, out the door, from about nine on a Friday
clues.step: Up to the plexiglass, order through the slot, and do not dawdle
clues.set: The order the man builds it in, and correcting him is not done

boards.scene: Central Texas, at the counter, by the pound

clues.priest: What the man with the knife is treated as, and he does not discourage it
clues.tips: Not the dish here. Here they are the burnt ends of a brisket, sold quietly
clues.pit: Brick, indirect, post oak, and it has not gone fully out since the seventies
clues.step: Along the counter as it is cut, one cut at a time, in front of you
clues.rest: An hour minimum, wrapped, and the whole day is arranged around it
clues.ripe: What the smoke smell is on your coat by the time you reach the car

boards.scene: Eastern Carolina, and the whole hog

clues.crafty: What twelve hours over coals with no thermometer actually requires
clues.fry: What the skin does at the end, and it is handed round before the meat
clues.fat: Rendered down and back into the chop, which is the whole argument for whole hog
clues.tray: Paper-lined, from the window, with slaw and hush puppies and no plate
clues.cart: Ash from the burn barrel to the pit, all night, by somebody's nephew
clues.cry: What the vinegar does to a cut on your hand, and the reason for gloves

boards.scene: The burn barrel, three in the morning

clues.ambush: What the wind does at about four, and the whole night turns on it
clues.ash: Shovelled, not swept, and its depth is how you read the fire
clues.mush: What the meat becomes if the shoveller sleeps, and it cannot be undone
clues.bus: The one that goes past at five and tells you how long you have been here
clues.hams: Two of them, over the coals, and they are the last thing to come off
clues.hub: The barrel itself, and everything that happens tonight happens around it

boards.scene: Sauce, and who is wrong about it

clues.misled: What everyone outside your county has been, on this subject, their whole life
clues.mild: On the South Side, in a squeeze bottle, and it is a specific thing not a spice level
clues.side: Which one of the Carolinas you are in, and it changes the whole recipe
clues.slid: Under the door of the argument, every family gathering, by an uncle
clues.lids: Off the bottles at the table, because it goes on after, not before
clues.dime: What the whole disagreement is worth, and it will outlive everyone present

clues.curate: What you do with a wood pile if you want it burning right in November
clues.cure: Before the smoke, in salt, and the day before matters as much as the day
clues.crate: Post oak, split, stacked by the fence, and seasoned since spring
clues.cart: Loaded twice because the first load was optimistic
clues.race: Against the rain, which is why the tarp is already in the truck
clues.acre: How far you can smell a Saturday from, out there, with the wind right

boards.scene: The trailer pit at the side of the road

clues.drafty: What the firebox door is, deliberately, and closing it fully kills the whole thing
clues.fry: The catfish on the flat top, for people who did not come for the ribs
clues.fat: Trimmed to a quarter inch, and the trimmings go in the beans
clues.tray: Handed through the window with a slice of bread doing the work of a plate
clues.yard: Somebody's, and the permit situation is best described as ongoing
clues.raft: Of smoke across the road at eleven, which is the only advertising there is

boards.scene: Sunday afternoon, and what is left

clues.pathos: The mood at four when the trays are down to bread and sauce
clues.ash: Grey, banked at the side, and still hot enough to matter tomorrow
clues.post: Oak, one log left, saved deliberately for the last hour
clues.hats: Off, finally, and the sunburn line is exactly where it was last year
clues.hot: The links, and the word is doing double duty on that sign
clues.oath: Sworn every year about starting earlier, and broken every year by noon
